label: IDENTITY_PREDICATE_ADMISSIBILITY_3: IdentityAdmissible D w means D admits the predicate v = w
definition: IdentityAdmissible D w means D admits the predicate v = w. Only this admission and local MC are needed to identify accessible successors with the root. Full world-predicate comprehension admits it; fixed languages and corpus inventories need not.
note: Repository-native mathematical fixture requested in #261. No historical attribution or metaphysical endorsement; source-based adoption requires a separate witnessed reading.

formal_gap.meaning: ResearchFixture.IdentityAdmissible D w says that the proposition domain D admits the identity predicate 'is the world w' (fun v => v = w). Its body applies the supplied domain D. It is a repository-native mathematical fixture (#261).
examples: A domain with full world-predicate comprehension, which admits every such identity predicate.
exclusions: A fixed language or a corpus inventory of propositions, which need not admit it.
Agreement of two worlds on every proposition of D (Agree): a separate relation, which does not by itself identify worlds.
open_obligations: Whether a given D contains complete propositions is an additional interpretive commitment.
No historical attribution or metaphysical endorsement; a source-based adoption would need a witnessed reading.
No formalization candidate: it is already a definition over the supplied domain; the remaining gap is the domain.
